payload.title: Google Ads conversions for anth.us
payload.description:
As the site owner, I want Google Ads campaigns to optimise on real leads, once ads begin.

Blocked until Google Ads campaigns start.

Steps: link GA4 to Google Ads; import generate_lead as the primary conversion; confirm Consent Mode signals (ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization) reach Ads; update the privacy policy to cover ad cookies before any ad tag loads.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Linked
  Given GA4 and Google Ads are linked
  Then generate_lead is imported and set as the primary conversion
Scenario: Consent respected
  Given a visitor has not accepted
  Then ad signals stay denied and no ad cookies are set
Scenario: Policy first
  Given the privacy policy mentions Google Ads
  Then it was published before any ad tag loaded

Dependencies: blocked-by key-event issue and consent banner issue.
